title: Ask HN: ML-Based Tool Feedback
excerpt: Hello all, I have built this free, open-source Flask-based web application https://diabetesriskanalyzer.org/ for a high-school science competition. The objective is to predict diabetes risk using lifestyle markers (BP, BMI, age etc) and I have deployed the model on AWS.
content_html:
Hello all, I have built this free, open-source Flask-based web application https://diabetesriskanalyzer.org/ for a high-school science competition. The objective is to predict diabetes risk using lifestyle markers (BP, BMI, age etc) and I have deployed the model on AWS.

Here is the research paper I have published at NHSJS: https://nhsjs.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Using-Lifestyle-Markers-and-Machine-Learning-to-Detect-Diabetes.pdf.

My github repository for this project is here: https://github.com/Armoredpawn/Diabetes-Likelihood

Please provide me feedback on the utility and other aspects for this web application.

Thank you!

Here is the research paper I have published at NHSJS: https://nhsjs.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Using-Lifestyle-Markers-and-Machine-Learning-to-Detect-Diabetes.pdf.

My github repository for this project is here: https://github.com/Armoredpawn/Diabetes-Likelihood

Please provide me feedback on the utility and other aspects for this web application.

谢谢你！
